meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: A plaintiff may have a cause of action under section 9 of the Partition Ordinance if defendants knowingly omitted to disclose interests in partition proceedings, even if the mortgagee had notice that the suit was settled.
rules.supporting_quote: "Taking these to be the facts, I come to the conclusion, in the first place, that, prima facie, the plaintiffs have a cause of action under section 9, on that ground that the defendants knowingly omitted to disclose the interests of Peduru and of the plaintiffs in the partition suit."
